item.title: ESP32 by Example, AI coding, and M5Stack hardware — EEI #62
item.summary: Elektor is taking its ESP32 by Example learning course beyond its original book-and-kit format, adding AI-assisted development and M5Stack hardware to the discussion in Elektor Engineering Insights #62 on Wednesday, 26 August 2026. Author James Solderitsch, an adjunct professor in Villanova University’s Department of Computing Sciences, will join Elektor editor Brian Tristam Williams for the […] The post ESP32 by Example, AI coding, and M5Stack hardware — EEI #62 appeared first on eeNews Europe .
